gloom_raids._note: Gloom Raids after every mission is won (Phase D, docs/PHASE_D_SPEC.md); not `raid` (the mission camp-falls numbers). The meter fills ONLY while the game runs: `meter.per_minute` points a minute while no fight is on, no raid is pending, the fire burns, the cat is up and the player touched the screen in the last `meter.idle_after` s (frame delta clamped to `meter.max_delta`), plus `meter.actions`, which never fill it past `meter.bump_cap`. Nothing reads the clock. At `meter.stir_at` the next raid is planned (its kind, trails, level and leader are fixed then); at `meter.full` it is pending and its warning (`warning`, always `warning.min`..`warning.max` s) starts when allowed. A raid is `waves` waves of lerp(count) (+1 per `count_per_level` raid levels) from its kind's pool; the last wave is cut to 60% and led by its leader (queue index `leader_at`); beating the leader routs the rest. Raid level = 1 + floor(max(0, camp score - level.camp_free) / level.camp_step) + floor(renown / level.renown_step), at most level.max (the first raid: - level.first_raid_minus). Renown +level.won_renown per raid held, -level.loss_renown per raid lost, 0..level.renown_cap. Strength = strength.base + strength.per_level x level, x (1 + strength.wave_ramp x (wave - 1)), the leader x leader_mult. Pay: shards round((pay.shards + pay.shards_per_level x level) x kind shards x (1 + pay.perfect if perfect + pay.ready if ready)); leaves pay.leaves + pay.leaves_per_level x level; timber pay.timber + floor(level / pay.timber_per_levels); keys pay.keys. A lost raid pays pay.lost_per_wave_held shards per wave held and takes nothing.

guardian._note: the Moss Warden, freed in the Gloomwood via stations.free_guardian() and woken at the Guardian Stone. Numbers = the stone level's entry x power_by_camp_level[home level] (fists and slam also x a dish's 'friends', health x 'guardian_hp'); every guardian look uses exactly these. In a wave it goes for enemies within its leash, first those hitting a building, a barricade, a tower or the campfire. Enemies within taunt_m of it fight it with structure-scale hits (gate_damage, no siege multiplier, range-checked). Slam when slam_min_foes are within slam_range (or a boss); foes with radius <= daze_radius are dazed slam_daze_s. Knocked down it pulls itself together after revive_s of mission time (x help_rate while the cat stands within help_range) at revive_hp, or whole at the next breather.

mission._note: how every mission runs (Draft 7): `waves` waves in chapters of `chapter_waves`; every chapter's last wave is an elite wave (the mission's `elite` enemies, more each chapter) and the mission's last wave brings its `boss`. Wave w has count[0]..count[1] ordinary enemies from its chapter's pool, spawned every[0]..every[1] s apart, at strength (base_strength + strength_per_mission x mission) x (1 + wave_ramp x (w - 1)); at most `max_alive` at once. A `breather` (s) between waves; after a chapter the camp rests until the player goes on from the signpost, and the game is saved there. Pay: kills drop `kill_pay` of their leaves; a cleared wave pays (wave_bonus + wave_bonus_step x w) leaves; a chapter pays chest_leaves / chest_timber [chapter]; all of it x (1 + pay_per_mission x mission). The win pays the mission's `reward` (replays: `replay_reward` of it). The campfire can be rebuilt once per chapter (`rebuild_s` on the ashes, `rebuild_timber`) and comes back at `rebuild_hp`; at every chapter break it is fed back to full. If a wave's last `flee_left` enemies (no boss) go `flee_after` s without one coming or falling, they flee so the wave can end.
mission._note_phase_f: Phase F (19 Nov 2026): roads = how a wave picks its roads (surround: all four, roads taking turns; pincer: two far apart; rush: one road, rush_count x enemies at rush_speed x speed, with a banner). A mission's `lanes` is now its favoured road (favoured_weight x share in surround; rushes come from it). teach_mission uses teach_roads_by_chapter roads (1, 2, then all 4). burst: enemies come in groups of size[0]..size[1], `spacing` s apart; the gap after a group keeps the chapter's average rate. min_wave_ratio: an ordinary wave is topped up (more enemies, up to max_alive) so its total health is at least this share of the wave before it (not after a chapter break, not the boss wave). boss_adds: share of a boss wave's ordinary enemies (a mission may override). bonus: quick clear (cleared within quick_base_s + quick_per_foe_s per enemy) pays quick_share x the wave bonus; intact (no building or defence ruined in the wave) pays intact_share x the wave bonus; Go early pays early_per_s leaves per breather second skipped (x the pay scale). golden_grub: from mission index from_mission, a chance per wave, it runs across the field and escapes after life_s; it never holds a wave up. totem: from mission index from_mission, a chance per ordinary wave, it grows on a road at trail progress `s`; foes within radius get speed_buff and take (1 - armor) damage; it is a foe (the wave waits for it). Mission keys: needs_home (the home level to start it), strength_mult, elite_by_chapter (replaces chapter+1), boss_adds, chapter pool_first + first_waves (the chapter's first waves use pool_first).
mission._note_phase_g1: Phase G1 (20 Nov 2026): wave_limits.groups by mission number (to_mission, 1-based): max_alive = the most enemies of a mission wave on the field at once; tanks_at_once = the most tank weight on the field at once (tank_weight: boar 0.5, the big ones 1; elites count, bosses do not); tank_share = the most tank weight in a whole wave as a share of its enemies. boss_others_on_field: with a boss alive, at most this many others on the field. min_wave_ratio now swaps weak kinds for stronger ones from the chapter pool (within the tank limits) and never adds enemies. Rush waves keep their count (roads.rush_count 1.0) and come rush_speed x faster. timber_per_wave: timber for each mission wave held (x the pay scale, rounded, at least 1). rebuild_leaves: the mid-mission campfire rebuild costs this many leaves when the cat has less than rebuild_timber timber.
mission._note_squads: Phase G1b: mission waves are planned from the chapter's `squads` (weights) instead of its random `pool`, until the wave reaches its count from `count`. Rules (squad_rules): from mission mixed_from on, a wave holds at least min_types different squad types; from mission share_from on, no kind is more than max_kind_share of a wave; the chapter's first_waves still use only its first squad. A squad spawns together on one road only when the field has room for all of it and the tank limit allows it. Elites lead their own squads (the elite plus elite_escort light enemies from the chapter's squads). The boss wave: each `boss` entry plus the mission's boss_escort squads.

building_hp._note: health of each building by its level (index 0 unused)

burrows._note: The Burrows (docs/DUNGEON_SPEC.md; Phase E: docs/PHASE_E_SPEC.md), open once every mission is won. Entry is free and unlimited (the user, 18 Nov 2026); a Hollow key is only a bonus: entering with one starts the run with a boon. A Burrow is a dungeon: one continuous map at night (data/dungeons/<map>.json), a path the cat walks from the way in past fights (packs that wake, spawners that fire) to a boss in a big arena (or a treasure clearing), built far from the camp at origin. Replays are levels of the same map: level 1 is open when the Hollow opens, beating level N opens N+1 (Save burrow stats depth = the highest level beaten). Every per-depth table below is per level. Monster health x strength_by_depth x (1 + fight_ramp x the fight's number); bosses x the map's hp_mult; damage = the kind's damage + damage_add_by_depth. Packs: the map's base + per_level x (level - 1) monsters from the level's tier pool (tiers[].first = the level a pool starts), at most max_alive_by_quality; a Gloomtouched elite may join a pack (pack_elite_chance_by_level, from level 1) and from level 2 a Root Snapper (snapper_chance_by_depth). A waking pack wakes any pack asleep within link_r of it (a pull). The spring heals spring.heal of the cat's health; a dew bud blooms where a fight with a pip was won with dew.bud_chance. Harder from 19 Nov 2026 (the user: "make the dungeon quite a lot harder"): strength, damage_add, fight_ramp, elites, wake_r, link_r, max_alive (Medium/High), boss_minions_max, dew, spring, and pay +25% (leaf_mult_by_depth, drops) to match; the boss's own tuning is in the map's end.mods. The first run ever at level 1 uses the map's fixed packs. Keys only from play; nothing is ever given, refilled or taken by time. Satchel: all of it banked on a root lift, knockout_keep of it on a knock-out; leaves, timber and shards are banked at once. A drop value v = floor(v) + a chance frac(v) of one more. Past level 5: strength +strength_per_depth_after a level, pay x (1 + pay_per_depth_after x (level - 5)). `list` holds every Burrow (one now): a new one is data plus models. sealed_guardian: the Moss Warden waits sealed behind the boss on the first clear of that level.

enemy_roles._note: Phase G1b: what each kind does in a squad. light: fast, many; fighter: charges; tank: in front, soaks; support: stays behind (shoots, heals, drums); leader: an elite that leads a squad.

squads._note: Phase G1b (approved by the owner 20 Nov 2026): a wave is a list of squads, small teams with roles. members: kind and n = [min, max]. from_mission: the mission (1-based) it first appears in. A squad comes down one road together: the tank (or the fighter, or the first member) leads, light ones keep pace, support stays a few steps behind; near the camp they break off. Elite waves: squads led by the mission's elite. Boss wave: the boss with the mission's boss_escort squads.
